bgDark.note: Main footer body — link columns, contact block, awards

bgMedium.note: Partner/brand affiliation strip (Radisson Individuals · Radisson · RewardsPandox)

bgLight.note: Bottom copyright/credit bar — use dark text

textOnLight.note: Text on bgLight — dark for AA contrast on #BBBBBB

accent.note: Footer accent (icons, column headers, CTA strip) — same as nav amber

art.note: --cat-art. Card / event category. Exact brand teal.

sport.note: --cat-sport. Card / event category. Exact brand amber. Text on fill: Ink #1A2B4A.

music.note: --cat-music. Card / event category. Exact brand coral. Text on fill: Ink #1A2B4A.

food.note: --cat-food. Card / event category. Brand gold / amber-dark. Text on fill: Ink #1A2B4A (white fails AA at small sizes).

neighbourhood.note: --cat-nbhd. Card / event category. Exact brand forest green.

community.note: --cat-community. Card / event category. Reuses --navy (Pantone 3015 U) — first brand token claimed by both a status badge (Conference) and a category token. Text on fill: White #FFFFFF (~5.9:1).

art.note: Map pin — Art. Exact brand teal. Palette v2 (Neighbourhood Teaser Addendum §7).

museum.note: Map pin — Museum. Exact brand gold — distinct from Art.

shopping.note: Map pin — Shopping. Brand purple, slightly deepened for separation from Party.

bar.note: Map pin — Bar. Brand coral pulled back ~15% (full coral reserved for hero/rooms CTA).

restaurant.note: Map pin — Restaurant. New terracotta; no prior token.

parks.note: Map pin — Parks and Nature. Exact brand forest green.

sightseeing.note: Map pin — Sightseeing. Brand amber, pulled back slightly.

kids.note: Map pin — Kids. Provisional pending taxonomy (category vs targetAudience).

hotelFill.note: Hotel map marker fill — brand amber. Same on / and /here; does not track page accent (forest/teal).

hotelInk.note: Hotel map marker Home glyph (and person-pin fallback fill). Not the hotel pin fill.

espresso.note: Home Lütze / Eat & Drink section accent (heading, chip borders, SweepCta). Pair to forest on /here.

surface.note: --surface-dining. Homepage Eat & Drink section ground — light tint of espresso (same role as rooms.surface / meetings.surface).

chip.note: --dining-chip. Off-white fill for fact chips under the Eat & Drink photos.

forest.note: Guest-hub dining band accent (heading, chips, service cards, SweepCta). DESIGN.md --forest / hbb-deep-forest. Not canonical green #56674F.

highlight.note: Rooms pages only (index + detail) — prices, nav rail active state, carousel dots, amenity icon strokes. Distinct from --coral (#F95D62). AA for large text only (~4.1:1 on white); do not use as body-copy fill. Large Sleep & Relax heading + decorative photo accent bar.

surface.note: --surface-rooms. Sleep & Relax / homepage rooms teaser section ground (replaces --bg-subtle for this band only).

accentText.note: --rooms-accent-text. Small red type + Discover-our-rooms SweepCta on the homepage rooms teaser. Distinct from --rooms-highlight heading red.

imagePanel.note: --image-panel. Rooms teaser photo mask placeholder ground while slides load / when empty.

highlight.note: Meet & Work panel / SweepCta / typewriter caption on the homepage teaser.

surface.note: --surface-meetings. Homepage Meet & Work section ground — light tint of meetings.highlight (same role as rooms.surface).

amberDeep.note: Im Haus amenity eyebrow / empty-media icon. DESIGN.md --amber-deep. 4.84:1 on panel-grey.

nbhd.note: Hub people cards. Same hex as --green / --cat-nbhd.

bgSubtle.note: --bg-subtle. Neutral / calm section tint (home rooms teaser). Also cards, inputs.

amberLight.note: --amber-light. ~10% --amber (#F79B2E) into white. Sport / main-site accent sections.

greenLight.note: --green-light. ~10–12% --green (#56674F) into white. Neighbourhood sections. May need 14–16% (~#DEE2DE) if too subtle in review.

surfaceDark.note: --surface-dark. Homepage map header + book-direct CTA strip bookends.

onDark.note: --on-dark. Body text + primary button fill on surface-dark. 9.3:1 on #2C3E34.

onDarkLink.note: --on-dark-link. Links + focus ring on surface-dark. 6.6:1 on #2C3E34.
